result.summary: The screen is mostly well-structured, but one section header is rendering a raw localization key instead of translated text, which is the standout defect. A few secondary inconsistencies in the restaurant cards and carousel were also noted.

issues.description: The second section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title such as 'Popular near you'. The missing translation string is visible to end users.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation entry for 'home_feed.popular_title' in the active locale files and add a fallback so untranslated keys render a default English string rather than the key path.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two popular restaurant cards use different treatments: the ramen card has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card has a dark/transparent circle with a white heart. This inconsistency looks like a rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button styling (same background, icon color, and opacity) across all cards, ideally with a translucent scrim that guarantees contrast over any image.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card ('Trattoria Piccol…') is clipped mid-word at the screen edge with no visible affordance that the list scrolls horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent trailing padding/peek width so the cut-off card clearly reads as a scroll hint, and truncate the title with an ellipsis rather than letting it clip at the viewport edge.

issues.description: The 'See all' links and promo body text are green/grey on white at small sizes; the secondary metadata ('€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') is light grey and may fall below the 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text colors to meet WCAG AA contrast and verify the green link color against white.

issues.description: The notification bell has a red dot badge with no accompanying count or text label, so its state is conveyed by color alone.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessible label such as 'Notifications, 1 unread' and consider showing a numeric badge.
